patch_description:
The previous program likely failed validation due to potential runtime errors in input handling (e.g., None values in bar_context) or subtle structural issues that caused the importer to fail. My fix addresses this by:
1. Implementing much more robust input sanitization, ensuring all bar_context values (atr, rsi, adx, close) are defaulted and type-cast to floats safely, even if they are None.
2. Using a cleaner logic structure to avoid any potential initialization issues.
3. Adding a refined trend filter using ADX (to adjust entry thresholds) and RSI (to prevent overextended trades).
4. Implementing ATR-based position sizing and asymmetric take-profit/stop-loss logic to improve risk-adjusted returns (Sharpe/Calmar).
5. Ensuring the final output dictionary has uniform types and handles the zero-signal case explicitly.
